## Calculated Values {#sec-calculated}

Parameters derived from mathematical formulas and economic models.

### Global Deaths per Minute from Disease: 104 deaths/minute {#sec-global_disease_deaths_per_minute}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Global deaths per minute from all disease and aging

**Inputs**:

- [Global Daily Deaths from Disease and Aging](#sec-global_disease_deaths_daily) 📊: 150 thousand deaths/day (SE: ±7,500 deaths/day)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Deaths_{disease,min} \\
= Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 0.000694 \\
= 150{,}000 \times 0.000694 \\
= 104
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

## External Data Sources {#sec-external}

Parameters sourced from peer-reviewed publications, institutional databases, and authoritative reports.

### Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification: 8.2 years {#sec-efficacy_lag_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Regulatory delay for efficacy testing (Phase II/III) post-safety verification. Based on BIO 2021 industry survey. Note: This is for drugs that COMPLETE the pipeline - survivor bias means actual delay for any given disease may be longer if candidates fail and must restart.

**Source**: [@bio-clinical-development-2021]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: Distribution: Normal (SE: 2 years)

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-efficacy_lag_years.qmd >}}

*~ Medium confidence • 📊 Peer-reviewed • Updated 2021*

:::
